items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: GDR, no. All the other ones, yes.

ctx.x: Are you finding yourself being asked for commissions from someone like the GDR/DDR Radio Bands in Germany or any of the... is there?

GDR, no. All the other ones, yes. And let’s see. The last commission that I got was two years ago and that was for the Boys Choir big band piece. It was played in the Morris Festival and that was like 80-90 people.
